title: Steelmaking Continuous-Casting Cooling-Water Integrity Record
description: Evidence model for the continuous-casting machine (CCM) mold and strand cooling-water system integrity verification, performed before each casting sequence (tundish open) to prevent the water-to-molten-steel steam explosion that occurs when a mold cooling-jacket leak or secondary-spray fault allows water to contact the molten-steel strand. Distinct from molten-metal-furnace repair LOTO + refractory-moisture control (which governs furnace repair lockout); this record governs the continuous-caster cooling-water SYSTEM in the running (non-isolated) state immediately before tap-into-tundish. Applicable to POSCO Gwangyang/Pohang, Hyundai Steel Dangjin, and Dongkuk MCS continuous casters.

caster_strand_id.description: Continuous caster and strand identifier (e.g., 'CCM#2-Strand-B', 'No.3 Billet-Caster-Strand-1').

mold_cooling_water_flow_lpm.description: Mold cooling-water flow rate (liters/minute). Must meet or exceed the mold-design minimum flow (typically 300-600 lpm for slab molds, 200+ lpm for billet molds). Below-minimum flow risks mold-shell breakout and molten-steel water contact.

mold_water_inlet_pressure_bar.description: Mold cooling-water inlet pressure (bar). Verified within the design band (typically 3-8 bar) to confirm no blockage in the mold-cooling channels.

mold_water_temperature_delta_c.description: Temperature rise ( C) of mold cooling water between inlet and outlet. A delta below 5 C during a hot standby indicates no heat extraction (channel blockage); an abnormally high delta indicates insufficient flow.

secondary_cooling_spray_active.description: True if all strand secondary-cooling spray banks (footroll, bending, straightening zones) are confirmed active and atomizing. A dry spray zone allows strand-breakout shell re-melt and molten-steel water-contact in the lower banks.

hydrostatic_leak_test_passed.description: True if the pre-shift mold/copper-plate hydrostatic leak test passed (no water-to-molten-metal path). Site PTW practice under OSHA-KR Article 38 (안전조치) and KOSHA guidance requires this verification before casting (anchor corrected from legacy Art 98 on 2026-08-24).

pre_cast_inspector_id.description: Identifier of the continuous-caster shift inspector who certified the cooling-water system (caster-crew qualification ID or safety-department assessor ID).

verification_timestamp_iso.description: Pre-cast verification timestamp (ISO 8601). Must be within the same shift as the tundish-open that follows it.
